purpose: Matched external test of whether ecological history older than one year has different predictive value for coarse seagrass presence and quantitative total cover at the same Sarasota fixed monitoring sites.

panel_construction.annual_state: one state per fixed site x calendar year using the program's primary annual visit; if schema documents multiple county visits in a year, aggregate only by a rule frozen before response rows are opened, otherwise stop
panel_construction.coarse_state: explicit overall seagrass sampled presence/absence, encoded 0/1
panel_construction.missing: missing/not-surveyed remains missing and can never create a zero
panel_construction.transition_requirement: target year equals source year + 1 at the same fixed site
panel_construction.history_requirement: older-history comparison requires at least two observed states strictly older than the source year
panel_construction.matched_rows: both state dimensions use the same eligible fixed-site x target-year rows

prediction_design.split: strict walk-forward by target calendar year; target year y trains only on eligible rows with target year < y

older_history_operator.type: exponentially weighted mean of all observed states strictly before the source year

prediction_design.common_loss: mean squared error on [0,1] for both coarse and quantitative states

support_rules.lag1: supported separately for a state dimension only if lag1 beats baseline in >=60% of scored target years, median paired MSE delta (lag1-baseline) < 0, and one-sided paired target-year sign-flip p < 0.05
support_rules.older_history: supported separately for a state dimension only if older-history beats lag1 in >=60% of scored target years, median paired MSE delta (older-lag1) < 0, and one-sided paired target-year sign-flip p < 0.05
support_rules.primary_state_dimension_prediction: lag1 support for both dimensions; older-history support for coarse presence but not quantitative cover

protocol_discontinuity_rules.2018: omit because the program reports no survey
protocol_discontinuity_rules.2019: retain only observed fixed-site rows; do not infer unobserved sites
protocol_discontinuity_rules.2024_and_later: excluded from primary because the county report documents a shift from winter to growing-season monitoring

claim_boundary: A matching result would replicate predictive state-dimension structure, not identify its biological mechanism.
A negative or non-estimable result is retained and does not trigger alternate threshold/species/unit selection.
Do not infer demographic extinction from recorded absence.
Do not infer a universal memory timescale from tau=10.
